_comment: Copy to feeds.json (gitignored) and put YOUR OWN feeds in it — this one neutral example is a placeholder, not a recommendation. Each entry is {url, tag?, title?}: `tag` defaults to the feed's host and becomes the page's `feed:` frontmatter key plus a tag, `title` defaults to the feed's own <title>. A bare URL string works too. Every NEW item costs one `claude -p` call, so start with a few feeds and read README.md on the caps first.
